claims.scope: kHYPE withdrawal queue and confirmation in StakingManager

preconditions.text: A user queues a withdrawal of a specified kHYPE amount via queueWithdrawal.; At queue time the exchange rate is used to determine the HYPE amount the user can withdraw.; The minimum withdrawal period (7 days minimum) has ended before confirmation.; The exchange rate decreases during the period between queue and confirmation (e.g., due to slashing).
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: The HYPE amount paid on confirmation should be determined by the exchange rate at confirmation time, not the rate at queue time.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: effectively extracting value from the protocol
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The exchange rate at confirmation time is observable and yields a well-defined HYPE amount payable.
The queue-time HYPE amount is fixed at queue time and carried into confirmation.
The rate decrease is treated as an external event (e.g., slashing) rather than attacker-induced.

limitations: The selected impact 'effectively extracting value from the protocol' is formalized as the paid amount differing from the confirmation-time rate amount; the 20 HYPE profit figure is not part of this claim.
Bank-run and insolvency impacts are not covered by this plan.
The 7-day minimum is represented as an elapsed-period Boolean rather than a numeric duration comparison.
